common_diagnostics.normalized_scores: optional secondary scores over fixed S0/S1
common_diagnostics.use: held-out diagnostics only; no training, checkpoint or scale selection

comparisons.A: M2_16 vs M1_16: same 16 sites, additional derivative labels
comparisons.B: M2_16 vs M1_32: equal C_label=32 only at q1=1; different sites/operations/time

costs.import_preparation: count two values, two derivatives, two curvatures per actual oracle import; do not count import as zero or multiply by all 60 models if one shared process
costs.q1_status: accounting convention only; actual relative cost not measured
costs.time_and_hardware_budget: not verified; no timing or equal CPU-cost claim
costs.unique_decision_label_sites: not knowable before future execution; caches and prior labels reused with exact float p and provenance

decisions.primary_score: arithmetic mean of the three raw D at strictly interior tasks; no clipping
decisions.reference_status: conditional floating M0; no certified regret
secondary_outputs: exact boundary membership mismatch against saved physical branch

selector.grid_rule: a+(b-a)*j/1024 for interior j; explicitly a and b at endpoints
selector.tie_rule: first (smallest p) when computed objectives equal

design_origin: planned after seeing pilots 2A/2B; exploratory, not blind or pre-registered before all data

failure_rules.available_partial_results: descriptive only with seed IDs and missingness; no imputation, no best-seed selection, no replacement seeds
failure_rules.constant_or_negligible_scores: undefined/poor discrimination reported as such; no artificial zero correlation
failure_rules.hash_or_provenance_mismatch: hold execution and inferential analysis pending resolution; do not overwrite historical data
failure_rules.missing_primary_outputs: mark campaign incomplete; primary planned 20-seed correlations/paired intervals withheld unless all 60 primary snapshots are valid
failure_rules.nonfinite_or_divergence: stop affected trajectory; preserve completed updates, parameters/moments if finite, and incident; no automatic restart or budget tuning
failure_rules.software_correction: preserve every attempt and its provenance; rerun only after explicit future authorization when necessary, never to improve scores

future_statistics.Spearman_ties: average ranks for exact stored-value ties, without rounding/rank clipping

bootstrap.if_enough: percentiles on defined replicates, with denominator and conditional-defined status
bootstrap.joint_Delta_definition: both correlations must be defined in a replicate
bootstrap.percentile_rule: linear interpolation at (n-1)*q on sorted defined replicates (type 7)
bootstrap.undefined_replicates: preserve indices, reasons, counts and frequency
bootstrap.unit: resample 20 seed IDs with replacement, retain every associated condition/snapshot/task

comparisons.S: mean raw D over three strictly interior tasks
comparisons.negative_difference_interpretation: lower observed cost difference for M2 in the pair; exploratory

hypothesis.historical_definition: Delta_rho=rho(E1_validation, mean exact regret)-rho(E0_validation, mean exact regret)
hypothesis.historical_text:
**Hypothèse H :** à architecture, tâches et budget de supervision fixés, le score d'erreur de dérivée sur validation ordonne les regrets de décision mieux que le score d'erreur de valeur, notamment parmi les réseaux de faible erreur prédictive.

Version mesurable proposée : pour chaque réseau j, calculer son regret moyen sur un même ensemble de tâches et comparer les corrélations de rang de Spearman :
\[
\Delta\rho=\rho(E_{1,\mathrm{val},j},\overline R_j)
           -\rho(E_{0,\mathrm{val},j},\overline R_j).
\]
H prédit Δρ>0. Une valeur Δρ≤0 va contre H dans ce protocole. Si les scores sont constants, les regrets négligeables ou le sous-ensemble de réseaux précis trop petit, le résultat est **non concluant**, sans inventer un avantage.
hypothesis.normalization_note: fixed positive S0/S1 do not change ranks; no scales fitted on diagnostic sites
hypothesis.operational_revision_after_pilot: M1_16 only, across all 20 seeds at 3000; unnormalised physical RMSE over 257 held-out points and mean raw D over three interior tasks; no low-E0 filter; D is not certified exact regret
hypothesis.other_conditions_and_snapshot_300: secondary, analysed separately; no pooling methods/snapshots
hypothesis.precision_subgroup: not primary; no post-hoc selection by observed scores; historical threshold remains historical
hypothesis.replication_unit: seed; all tasks, conditions, snapshots are associated measurements

physical_model.threshold_status: float evaluations of exact physical thresholds; not certified

initialization.draw_order: 16 w draws, then 16 v draws; no draws for biases
initialization.seed: each declared seed using a local random.Random(seed)

replication.logging: one extra loss-and-gradient evaluation per control; accounted separately from updates; fixed, not selected by validation

training_sites.labels: exact analytic expressions evaluated in floats, no added noise
